title: Dietary Supplement GMP: 21 CFR 111 Compliance & FDA Enforcement
excerpt: 21 CFR Part 111 requires all dietary supplement manufacturers to follow current good manufacturing practices for identity testing, specifications, and documentation. With 34 CGMP-related enforcement actions in our database and nearly half of inspected facilities receiving FDA citations, supplement GMP compliance remains the industry's most persistent regulatory challenge.
seo_title: Dietary Supplement GMP Requirements: FDA 21 CFR 111 | Policy Canary
seo_description: Complete guide to dietary supplement GMP compliance under 21 CFR Part 111. Covers the five most common FDA violations, warning letter patterns, third-party certification (NSF, USP, ConsumerLab), the Dietary Supplement Listing Act of 2026, and what manufacturers should do now.
